name: Java
description: Java syntax, object-oriented design, collections, concurrency, the JVM and building services with Spring Boot.

nodes.name: Java basics
nodes.desc: Types, variables, operators, control flow and compiling and running a Java program.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write, compile and run simple Java programs using primitive types, operators and control flow.
topics: Compiling with javac and running with java
The main method and program structure

nodes.name: Methods & arrays
nodes.desc: Static methods, arrays, the String class and StringBuilder.
nodes.summary: You will be able to organise code into static methods and work with arrays, String and StringBuilder efficiently.

nodes.name: Classes & objects
nodes.desc: Classes, constructors, encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism in Java.
nodes.summary: You will be able to model problems with Java classes using constructors, encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism.

nodes.name: Interfaces
nodes.desc: Interfaces, abstract classes, default methods and programming to an interface.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose between interfaces and abstract classes and write code against interfaces rather than implementations.

nodes.name: Exceptions
nodes.desc: Checked and unchecked exceptions, try-with-resources and custom exceptions.
nodes.summary: You will be able to handle and throw checked and unchecked exceptions, manage resources with try-with-resources and define custom exceptions.

nodes.name: Enums & records
nodes.desc: Enums with behaviour, records as immutable data carriers, and sealed types.
nodes.summary: You will be able to model fixed sets of values with enums, immutable data with records and closed hierarchies with sealed types.

nodes.name: Generics
nodes.desc: Generic classes and methods, bounded types and wildcards.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write type-safe generic classes and methods and use bounded types and wildcards correctly.

nodes.name: Collections
nodes.desc: List, Set, Map and Queue implementations, equals/hashCode and choosing the right one.
nodes.summary: You will be able to pick the right List, Set, Map or Queue implementation and implement equals and hashCode consistently.

nodes.name: Lambdas & streams
nodes.desc: Functional interfaces, lambdas, method references and the Streams API.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write concise data-processing code with lambdas, method references and the Streams API.

nodes.name: Bank system project
nodes.desc: Model accounts, transactions and reports in a console banking app with clean OOP.
nodes.summary: You will build a console banking application with accounts, transactions and reports designed with clean object-oriented structure.

nodes.name: Threads & executors
nodes.desc: Threads, executors, futures, synchronized and the java.util.concurrent toolkit.
nodes.summary: You will be able to run concurrent work with threads and executors and coordinate it safely with synchronisation and concurrent utilities.

nodes.name: JVM & GC
nodes.desc: Bytecode, class loading, the heap and stack, and how garbage collectors work.
nodes.summary: You will understand how the JVM loads and runs bytecode, how memory is laid out and how garbage collectors reclaim objects.

nodes.name: Maven & Gradle
nodes.desc: Project layout, dependencies and builds with Maven or Gradle.
nodes.summary: You will be able to structure a Java project and manage dependencies and builds with Maven or Gradle.

nodes.name: JUnit testing
nodes.desc: Unit tests, assertions, parameterised tests and mocking with JUnit and Mockito.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write unit tests with JUnit 5, including parameterised tests, and isolate dependencies with Mockito.

nodes.name: JDBC
nodes.desc: Connecting to a relational database, prepared statements and transactions from Java.
nodes.summary: You will be able to connect Java code to a relational database with JDBC, run prepared statements and manage transactions.

nodes.name: Spring Boot
nodes.desc: Dependency injection, controllers and data access with Spring Boot.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build Spring Boot applications using dependency injection, REST controllers and Spring Data repositories.

nodes.name: REST service project
nodes.desc: Build a tested Spring Boot REST service backed by a database.
nodes.summary: You will build a tested Spring Boot REST service backed by a database, with validation and proper error responses.
topics: Integration tests with a test database
